antwort.text: Im Median vergehen 7 Tage zwischen der Registrierung eines Kontos und dem Start des ersten Pro-Abos.
antwort.sql:
WITH first_abo AS (
  SELECT 
    c.customer_id,
    s.started_at,
    c.signup_at,
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM (s.started_at - c.signup_at)) AS days_to_first_abo,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.customer_id ORDER BY s.started_at) AS rn
  FROM customers c
  INNER JOIN subscriptions s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
  WHERE s.started_at >= c.signup_at
)
SELECT 
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_to_first_abo) AS median_days
FROM first_abo
WHERE rn = 1 AND days_to_first_abo >= 0
